acceptance.criterion: Lighthouse SEO at least 0.95 on /, /resume/ and an exhibit page
acceptance.command: CHROME_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome npm run lh (mobile), then npx lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.desktop.cjs
acceptance.evidence: SEO 1.00 on all 9 mobile and all 9 desktop runs (/?test=1&mode=museum, /exhibit/verafin/?test=1&mode=museum, /resume/). Accessibility 1.00 on all mobile runs. The desktop config passes every assertion. The mobile config fails only largest-contentful-paint on / and /exhibit/verafin/ (3.83 to 3.92 s simulated, SwiftShader; /resume/ 1.35 s); the unchanged base df5a730 measures the same (3.83 to 3.89 s, /resume/ 1.35 s) and fails the same assertion, so it is not caused by this WP. That is WP-29's gate, not SEO.

OG card copy reuses site strings only (stopCards, heroLines, displayName). Cards for exhibits with exhibit.draft: true show their draft titles; once copy changes, the manifest test fails until npm run og is rerun. The home and resume cards use heroLines, which change on 2027-01-01 (Most recently: ...) and in May 2027 (no 'expected'); the build fails on those dates for the content reasons in CLAUDE.md anyway, and npm run og is part of that update.
The cards leave out durations and the ON VIEW NOW pill so they do not go stale each month.
requests: WP-32 / R0: tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts '/resume/ is the classic view with zero scripts' (lines 99 and 102) asserts no <script> element at all, so it fails now that /resume/ carries the JSON-LD Person required by this brief and ARCHITECTURE §11.3. Proposed: count only executable scripts, e.g. expect(text).not.toMatch(/<script\b(?![^>]*type="application\/ld\+json")/i) and page.locator('script:not([type="application/ld+json"])') toHaveCount(0). Executable-script safety is still enforced by scripts/prerender.ts and scripts/headers.ts.
WP-32 (optional): an e2e check that /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt are served, and that /og/<id>.png answers 200 for each og:image URL.
notes: JSON-LD is a type=application/ld+json data block with '<' escaped as \u003c; scripts/headers.ts already ignores it for the CSP hash. scripts/prerender.ts's zero-JS check on /resume/ and 404 now rejects only executable scripts.

gen-og embeds the @fontsource woff2 files as data URIs and aborts every request in the page; it fails if a font did not load. The favicon letters are glyph outlines (fontkit), so the SVG needs no font.
Local Chromium is revision 1243; a scratch PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH outside the repo mapped the 1194 names. Nothing about it is committed.
